contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the House of Valentinian (364-378), Victory left issue, Reece period 19. Obverse description: Bust diademed ?draped and cuirassed? right. Reverse description: Victory advancing left with wreath and palm. Reverse inscription: [SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE]. Diameter: 17.5mm, Weight: 2.09gms, die axis: 6
